purpose: Diagnose the sole remaining frozen C10.65r2 failure: exact numeric-text SHA identity of the dormant r2 OFF path versus the r1 control. Separate runtime repeatability, independent-build repeatability, and dormant-r2 code-generation effects without weakening or redefining C10.65r2.
tests: same_binary_repeat: execute the same r1 binary twice with identical physical input and different output roots; compare all four perturbation numeric rows byte-for-byte after removing comment lines
independent_r1_builds: build the identical r1 patch stack independently in two directories with the same compiler/options and compare the four outputs
r1_vs_dormant_r2: compare r1 against the current r2 patch stack with c10_65r2_diag=0
repeat the same three comparisons with OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 to distinguish thread scheduling from code-generation effects

frozen_reporting.exact_numeric_text_identity: required and reported independently for every comparison; do not round before the exact check
frozen_reporting.max_relative_difference: also report as a diagnostic only

next: If dormant-r2 codegen is isolated, redesign r2 instrumentation so production arithmetic is compiled from an unchanged translation unit (e.g. compile-time-separated diagnostic observer/helper) and rerun the original frozen C10.65r2 target unchanged. If baseline runtime/build nondeterminism is isolated, preserve the frozen failure and preregister a scientifically equivalent rollback criterion based on deterministic production-state hashing at a stable serialization point rather than silently weakening the old target.
